legend: You are given 2n$$$2n$$$ pairs (ai,bi)$$$(a_i, b_i)$$$ of integers. Consider a complete graph on 2n$$$2n$$$ vertices and define the weight of the edge (ij)$$$(ij)$$$ to be wij=max(|ai−aj|,|ai−bj|,|bi−aj|,|bi−bj|)$$$w_{ij} = max(|a_i-a_j|, |a_i-b_j|, |b_i-a_j|, |b_i-b_j|)$$$.
